claim: In the Provisioned Concurrency pricing section, duration charges apply to code that runs in the handler and to initialization code declared outside of the handler; with Lambda extensions, duration also includes the time the last running extension takes to finish during the shutdown phase.
question: Is initialization code billed as duration for a function with Provisioned Concurrency?

qualifiers.scope: functions with Provisioned Concurrency (pricing page note)
qualifiers.condition: stated in the Provisioned Concurrency Pricing section

note: adjudicate-18: narrowed to Provisioned Concurrency because the quoted note sits under the Provisioned Concurrency Pricing heading; for SnapStart functions the guide states the same rule (snapstart page). No saved page states the rule for on-demand functions.
